title: DOT-06: GAO-23-105189 Recommendation 1 identity and agency response
summary: DOT-06 resolves one-to-one to GAO-23-105189 Recommendation 1; the record preserves the affected component, current GAO status, agency response, and last visible update period.
key_findings: Phase 56P action: FAA should develop a comprehensive strategy for integrating drones into the national airspace system.
Affected component: Federal Aviation Administration; Administrator.
Current GAO status: Open; status period: March 2026.
Agency response: FAA reported a revised strategy under Office of the Secretary review and planned submission by June 30, 2026; GAO had not recorded completion.
Continuation rule: Recheck GAO-23-105189 Recommendation 1 when GAO changes the status or adds agency-response evidence after March 2026.
why_it_matters: The crosswalk replaces a letter-level local reference with an inspectable official report-and-recommendation identity where the evidence supports exactly one match.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves local action key DOT-06 as a crosswalk rather than an official identifier.
Separates official recommendation identity, affected entity, GAO status, agency response, implementation evidence, closure, and outcome.
Supports direct follow-through on GAO-23-105189 Recommendation 1.
evidence_limits: An agency response, concurrence, planned date, submission, or artifact under review does not by itself establish implementation or closure.
GAO recommendation status is not interchangeable with the Phase 56F entity evidence state.
Recommendation closure would not by itself establish operating performance, readiness, safety, value, or causation.
The official identity is the report number plus recommendation number shown on the GAO product page; FTFN does not invent a separate opaque database identifier.
